**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

The agreement imposes no non-compete or field-of-use restraint on our business. The restrictions binding us are confined to the Licensor's own technology — licence scope, no-sublicensing, no derivative works of the Licensed Technology — which the playbook treats as ordinary licence terms rather than restrictive covenants. The only non-solicit runs to Licensor employees. I noted the change-of-control consent point (p0134) in the rationale for the assignment rule to pick up, rather than flagging the same term twice here.
